title: Smiling Baby Girl in High Chair with Toy, 1961 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black-and-white domestic snapshot showing an upbeat, chubby-cheeked baby girl sitting comfortably in a padded high chair. Dressed in a light smock, she smiles cheerfully toward the camera with baby rattles and toys resting on her tray. The photograph features deckled edges and includes a laboratory processing stamp on the front margin reading 'OCT 1961', along with a handwritten pencil inscription on the reverse identifying her as 'Al Zimmerman's Girl'.
